# std/flake-builder's image (design/caos-expr.md, Phase 3 — "Breaking the
# cycles"). flake-builder cannot be built by flake-builder, so its image is the
# sentinel `--base:docker=seeded`: `resolve_expr_base` turns a `:docker=` ref
# into the blob `docker://seeded` with no dispatch (no re-entry into
# std/flake-builder), and the formed arg-tree is
# `{ base: docker://seeded, in: <this tree>, salt }`.
# Nothing ever pulls `docker://seeded`: the core-seeder-runner registered that
# exact key answers it with the pre-built flake-builder image (bootstrap's
# hand-built delta). If the seeder is absent the job hits the generic runner and
# fails loudly on a bogus image — an honest "bootstrap broken" signal, never a
# silent wrong answer.
run --base:docker=seeded --in:@=.
